description: Source code for Odoo modules related to manufacturing subproducts, BOM, and production workflows.

classes.name: mrp_subproduct
classes.description: Model representing a subproduct in manufacturing, with fields for product, quantity, UOM, type, and BOM relation.

classes.name: mrp_bom
classes.description: Model extending BOM with a one-to-many relation to subproducts.

classes.name: mrp_production
classes.description: Model extending production with a custom action_confirm method to create stock moves for subproducts.

methods.name: onchange_product_id
methods.description: Updates the product UOM when the product is changed.

methods.name: action_confirm
methods.description: Overrides the confirm action to generate stock moves for subproducts based on BOM and production data.
